rule: 1. we create a central view from source tables (by joining them , max upto 10). The join are selected so that it can feed sat as a whole (one or moew). That is we do not split sat across these views. Restriction of 10 can be broken if a sat needs more than source tables to build. If a view as less source tables join, we add more tables to it efficiently so that new sats can be built.
